business_summary: Hunan Creator Information Technologies CO., LTD. provides information services for digital government and smart enterprise in China. The company offers big data, private cloud, capability open, artificial intelligence, knowledge graph, machine vision, digital twin, trusted data collaboration, mobile development, internet of things, and data governance and management platform. It also provides government brain; collaborative office; internet plus government services; urban operation management service; internet plus supervision; new college entrance examination information management; traffic police intelligent duty supervision; strategic and emergency supplies reserve management; internet + transparent kitchen; smart party school system; non-tax middle; civil affairs integration; CPPCC cloud; integrated law enforcement; medical ethics and professional conduct evaluation management system; hospital integrity risk prevention and control system; DRGDIP integrated management; online monitoring system for investment and financing platform companies; police station grassroots policing work; government procurement full-process electronic system; portal website centralized resource unified management; and smart enterprise platforms. In addition, the company offers integrated operation and management, supply chain finance, smart office, unified payment, intelligent collaborative maintenance, and smart visitor products; and software development, system integration, and operation and maintenance services. Hunan Creator Information Technologies CO., LTD. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Changsha, China.
